evals.prompt: Go ahead and start the add-to-cart feature.
evals.expected_output: workflow invokes get-requirement first — does not skip to another stage
expectations: workflow identifies that it is in Stage 1
workflow invokes or names get-requirement as the skill to use
workflow does not invoke create-test-data or create-task without going through Stage 1 first
workflow does not perform get-requirement's procedure itself, such as asking gaps or writing steps

evals.prompt: Looks good, scenario.html is fine — let's move on.
evals.expected_output: workflow advances to Stage 2, invokes create-test-data, then PAUSEs again
expectations: workflow identifies that it is in Stage 2
workflow invokes or names create-test-data as the skill to use
workflow does not skip Stage 2 and jump straight to Stage 3
workflow states that it will PAUSE for user review after Stage 2 finishes

evals.prompt: All tasks done, all tests pass — keep going.
evals.expected_output: workflow advances to Stage 5, invokes api-test, then PAUSEs
expectations: workflow identifies that it is in Stage 5
workflow invokes or names api-test as the skill to use
workflow does not skip Stage 5 and jump straight to Stage 6
workflow does not perform api-test's procedure itself

evals.prompt: Didn't pass — E2E flow is missing the cleanup step.
evals.expected_output: workflow loops back to Stage 1 with the rejection reason as new input
expectations: workflow identifies this as a rejection and routes back to Stage 1
workflow passes the rejection reason (missing cleanup step) as input to get-requirement
workflow does not mark the scenario as done
workflow does not jump directly to Stage 2

evals.prompt: Context hasn't been set up yet — can we just start the login feature anyway?
evals.expected_output: workflow invokes initialize first and does not start Stage 1 yet
expectations: workflow detects that context/ or tech-stack/ is missing
workflow invokes or names initialize as the skill to run first
workflow does not invoke get-requirement until initialize is done

evals.prompt: Can you just write the addToCart function for me?
evals.expected_output: workflow declines to implement it directly and routes to the correct Stage 4 skill
expectations: workflow does not write code or implement any function itself
workflow identifies implementation as belonging to Stage 4 (code-task skill)
workflow explains that its own role is control-only

evals.prompt: There are still unit-test, integration-test, and code-task left — which one goes first?
evals.expected_output: workflow dispatches tasks one at a time by task.type — no parallel execution
expectations: workflow states that Stage 4 dispatches per task.type
workflow does not perform any task type's procedure itself
workflow names unit-test, integration-test, and code-task skills in task order

evals.prompt: Can we run unit-test and code-task at the same time to speed things up?
evals.expected_output: workflow declines because parallel execution conflicts with its Role & Boundary
expectations: workflow refuses to change routing logic that conflicts with its design
workflow explains that dispatch per task means one task at a time
workflow does not implement parallel execution logic

evals.prompt: Add to Cart is done and accepted — let's do the remove-from-cart feature next.
evals.expected_output: workflow starts a fresh cycle from Stage 1 for the new scenario
expectations: workflow confirms the previous scenario is done
workflow starts Stage 1 fresh for the remove-from-cart feature
workflow invokes get-requirement for the new requirement
workflow does not carry over state from the previous scenario
